gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-readex-pro: Outrun Future keeps its letters far apart and traces them in a single constant-width outline, pure synthwave authority. Readex Pro stays plain sans, with broad terminal gaps that let paragraphs run along without a snag.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-roboto: Roboto reads clean, with generous mouths on its round letters. Outrun Future earns its place big and brief, where its wide-set letters and constant-width strokes can carry the synthwave swagger.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-schibsted-gr: Open-looking e and a shapes with tall bowls make Schibsted Grotesk read approachable, its sans-serif terminals never closing in. Outrun Future adds a single, wide-spaced thread of synthwave on top.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sen: Wide-spaced letters traced in one constant outline: that is Outrun Future. Sen sits beneath in tall, modern lowercase, curved strokes ending before they turn inward, giving the loud heading some company.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sintony: Outrun Future has no thin hairline anywhere, just wide-set letters drawn in a constant-width outline. And Sintony, plain sans with a chunky, tall midzone, stays smooth beside it, no clogged curves.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sofia-sans-s: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps its lowercase nearly level with the capitals. Beneath Outrun Future, its stencil-like constant weight and big visible curve entrances make extended text glide along.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-stack-sans-h: Loud, spaced-out and synthwave: Outrun Future draws every letter with a constant-width outline. But Stack Sans Headline, plain sans with a monoline skeleton and wide gaps, keeps tiny sizes crisp.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sulphur-poin: Sulphur Point brings bulky lowercase and a steady, marker-like line. Sulphur Point keeps its open gaps clear line after line, a sans-serif that Outrun Future can lead without strain.
gen-dafont-over-there-gf-syncopate: Fixed-width-nib strokes and generous white space give Over There its vintage-military bark. Syncopate takes over with technical-pen steadiness and rung-like spacing, plain sans meant to let the heading command.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla is plain sans with wide s curves barely curled in, and a short stretch from midline to ascender. Plakkaat's heavy, near-closed letters make Anek Bangla's open forms feel friendlier.
